svg.title: Palace ground-plane return current
svg.desc: Palace driven Maxwell reference. Colors show magnitude of the complex conduction-current vector averaged through copper thickness. Arrows show the real instantaneous field at the selected phase. Copper is an explicitly meshed conductive volume.

g.text: Palace v0.14.0 · f = 1 MHz · |K|/t (A/mm²) · peak phasors
h = 0.8 mm · copper = 0.035 mm · sample grid = 80 × 80
FEM order 2 · conductive copper volumes · arrows at 90° · air/substrate domain · source currents normalized
